statement: The wheels do not turn in the model, and the drag of turning wheels is not part of the drag area
rationale: the tutorial's case has no rotating wall on the wheels and no moving ground under them; a turning wheel changes the flow under the bike and the drag

mechanism.how: A run with a rotating-wall condition on each wheel and the ground moving at 20 m/s, compared with this one; or a coast-down test of the real bike
